Complex & Clinical NDIS Care

Complex & Clinical NDIS Care

When the case is too complex for most providers, we are the provider that says yes.

Abundance Healthcare Group is a registered, nurse-led NDIS provider specialising in complex and high-intensity supports and clinical nursing care across Sydney and Perth. Whether you live with high needs, care for someone who does, or coordinate their plan, we have the capability and the capacity.

Why it is different

Nurse-led, not support-worker-only

Complex participants need more than rostered hours. Our care is designed and overseen by registered nurses, so clinical tasks are done safely and a change in someone's condition is recognised and acted on, not missed.

That clinical backbone is what lets us take the cases other providers decline, and it is what gives families and coordinators confidence that a person with high needs is in safe hands.

  • Registered nurses behind the care plan and clinical tasks
  • Support workers trained and supervised for high-intensity tasks
  • Clear clinical governance and incident escalation

The clinical difference

Care built around one complex person at a time

We currently support a participant living with motor neurone disease on 24-hour care, working alongside their family and coordinators as their needs change. It is the kind of complex, high-intensity engagement this team is built for.

We work with condition networks including MND NSW (Coordinators of Support, Gladesville) to support participants with progressive conditions.

Nurse-led plansClinical tasks designed and overseen by registered nurses.
Around the clockOvernight, sleepover and 24-hour arrangements at home.
Matched to cultureWorkers matched to language and culture where it matters.

A full participant story will be shared only with the participant's informed written consent.

Common questions

What people ask us

Do you have capacity for a high-intensity or 24/7 participant?
Capacity changes, so we answer honestly case by case. Tell us the participant's needs and we will say plainly whether we can take it and when we can start, rather than leaving you waiting.
What complex nursing tasks do you deliver?
PEG and enteral feeding, complex bowel care, catheter care, complex wound management, continence and medication support, delivered by or under the supervision of registered nurses as part of our Community Nursing Care registration (0114).
Are you registered for these supports?
Yes. We are a registered NDIS provider (Reg ID 4-JCLD6XE) holding thirteen registration groups, including High Intensity Daily Personal Activities (0104) and Community Nursing Care (0114). We only promote supports we are registered and able to deliver.
How do we get started?
Make an enquiry and we will come back with next steps, usually within one business day. If you are referring a participant and already have the clinical details, the referral page captures everything our nurses need in one go.
